description: This is a Java test class for the VariantDetector component, specifically testing emoji variant detection logic using JUnit. It includes methods to parse emoji data from strings, create temporary files, and verify variant relationships between emoji sequences.

classes.name: VariantDetectorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing emoji variant detection logic in the PersonDetector class.

methods.name: parseFromString
methods.description: Parses emoji data from a string by writing it to a temporary file and then parsing it with UnicodeOrgEmojiTestDataParser.

methods.name: testPersonDetectorHappyPath
methods.description: JUnit test verifying that the PersonDetector correctly identifies variant and non-variant emoji sequences for hands and vulcan salute emojis.

methods.name: testPersonDetectorFoldedHandsIssue
methods.description: JUnit test verifying variant detection for folded hands emoji with different skin tones.
